reviews.review_msg: One of the knowledgeable, respectful, kind, stylish and tech-savvy profs I've had at SFU for the past 2 years. I look forward to her class and stay till the last minute. Class starts with a review of the past lesson, an overview and explanation of the new theories, practice of the new material, and a revamp. Tsoghik is super and TAs are too.
I just love Grigoryan. She is wonderful!

Tsoghik has been my favorite prof. Instead of banning policing against AI as other profs do she educates us on how to properly develop our skills to achieve our goals. Week 11 class was about AI in education. I learned how to use it, what prompts to give, what educational AI to use, and how to use it to fit the academic rules. love her classes!
Thanks a bunch for extra help and guidance. You rarely see a prof agree to help and give feedback after the lecture or without office hour bookings. Immensely thankful!!!

Only few weeks into the course and I already want to say how well Grigoryan discusses sensitive topics like racism, bias, culture so it doesn't hurt anyone's feelings. Really impressive. She is also helpful and prompt in feedback. She keeps the course organized in canvas. I'm not happy though with my TA Karen since she doesn't follow up on lectures

I'm CAL student and this prof understood my problems just looking at me and I felt so comfortable in class and she treated me well and helped throughout the course. I never felt I was different and accomplished a lot, and learned how to reference, write full academic texts, be and sound confident that I never felt. Gratitude !!!
Can't say enough good things about you Dr. Grigoryan. Thanks for being such a wonderful human :)

We've just started the course and I already love her lecturing. She is energetic, full of ideas asking you to think about your success, gives good lectures through prezi that's fun to follow and has a style. Looking forward to the rest of the course :) Super prof!

I will never stop hyping this prof. I'm really pleased with how organized this course is, rare for an elective. The prof explained all assessments clearly in Week 1. Weekly chapters, slides, rubrics and samples are all in modules. Nothing feels vague and she makes the course easy to follow and enjoyable. Stay organized and you can't go wrong!

Tsoghik is a very nice person, gentle, kind and organized. It was easy to follow the course because she posted the readings, rubrics, guides and PPTs on Canvas. Students had full access to course materials on time. It helped me prepare for sessions and feel on track. She is approachable and easygoing. Such a cool professor.

I'm in love with her teaching style and clarity of lectures. Dr. Grigoryan is one of those professors who cares about students' ideas and opinions, and so she brings in several debates to encourage discussion around the theories we studied. Honestly, I grasped the concepts from discussions. Also, I loved her professionalism and demeanor.
Super prof! I'll greatly miss her classes! I highly recommend her class to education students, especially those who favor up-to-date thinking and welcome technology!

I honestly feel like I've learned a lot already. She explains everything clearly and breaks down the writing in a way that actually makes sense. She also uses technology in class, which makes things more interactive and fun, not just a regular lecture. The expectations are clear, the feedback is helpful. I can already see improvement in my writing.

Best prof ever!!! She knows her job, is professional, gives detailed feedback, classes are super helpful and informative, grades loyally, posts on time, comes on time, smiles and shows respect to everyone, encourages learning and thinking. Highly recommended!

I've received an A for this course, and my grade speaks for itself, as I did excellently; it means the grading, feedback, and lectures were very clear for me to score that high. My suggestion: don't register students outside Education - they may not see the value of what the course offers.

Nice person, but all presentations for lecture are AI generated based on weekly readings. This means that they're messy, and unreadable. She also isn't clear on rubrics for assignments, the class is disorganized. That being said, the coursework she gives is not very difficult, it's just not very clear. Your money basically goes to AI instructions.

I won't lie, this course has been hard for me. I had to read every chapter twice to understand the material, but once in class, I followed what prof explained and got it :) Her teaching is extremely clear. Every week, I left the hall with a sense of satisfaction about my learning.

A big fat thank you for the course!!! Thank you for the end-of-course achievement awards and chocolates!!! You made the sessions fun, informative and challenging!!! The group project was awesome too and class debates were cool!! I'll look forward to signing up for another course with you!!!

I'll miss her lectures, - Tsoghik is incredibly knowledgeable and accurate in sharing information and feedback. - So down to earth, open and at the same time a professional prof that I never wanted the class to end. Thanks to the links she shared to help in the last class, I found a part-time job aligned with the course we covered. -

Dr. Tsoghik is by far the best professor I've had in my 2 years at SFU. She is so incredibly passionate and knowledgeable. She encourages different perspectives and really listens to what students have to say. Expectations are clear, and the assignments make you think about what you are learning and how it connects to education and the real world.

Thanks for the very productive course. I feel I've learned a lot about present challenges in education and as a future educator I feel challenged and eager to continue researching the ideas we discussed in sessions. Brilliant lectures!!!!

Prof taught several theories in a session and TAs practised those in tutorials. No exaggerated assignments and multiple choice tests. Instead, a creative major project and final presentations. I enjoyed scenarios she gave and discussions, also end-of class reviews. Loved to be in this course. My TA did great too.

This was probably the easiest course I've taken at SFU. She does use A LOT of AI though, so if you're against that you probably won't enjoy the lectures. The material was kind of boring but I'm also not an EDUC major so that's probably why. If you're looking for an easy elective take this course!!

Very nice person and a brilliant prof! In the last class of the course she introduced lists of conferences, webinars, PD sessions, publication and research opportunities, volunteering platforms aligned to every topic we had covered for the course. I successfully registered to some and I'm grateful for this information. It was eye opening.

Simply the best prof in my learning!!! loved the way she uses interactive platforms, makes the session so informative and easy to follow, allows experimenting, researching new ways in learning and is not judgmental at all. I'd take other classes with her, truly admire her professionalism.

I agree, Tsoghik is very generous with rewards, information, time after class, feedback. Prof who knows how to explain massive theories in such simple ways so students can get them. I read the chapters myself and didn't get anything, once in class they all made sense as prof knows how to teach them. I learned a lot in this course. Massive thanks!!!

Dr Grigoryan is the most generous prof I've known. I guess she spent half of her wage on reward chocolates for students. She didn't make us buy books or class materials. instead posted all on canvas, Every class ppt, rubrics, extras were on canvas before each class for us to follow. TAs worked from the same page, coordinated. Enjoyed this course!

Such a wonderful final class we had today. I haven't seen any prof to nominate her students with achievements awards and chocolates. I can't believe we've studies 45 theories and frameworks for this course, big achievement and I remember almost all of them. Thanks a million!!!!!

Prof with a style, helpful, knowledgeable, innovative, down-to-earth, delivers very interesting classes, explains in simple terms so the hardest theory is easy to grasp, connects all to real-life examples, brings in scenarios to elicit the material, and more. I haven't missed any of the classes. Thanks for the great work!!!!

Beautiful person and prof with years of experience you can tell. Her online published work is based on ed-tech and she's nicely using tech in her sessions to make classes interactive. The course is hard for me, there's too much to remember, but it's important for my future research. Just wanted say I enjoyed her course, it's different from others.

It's been a wonderful journey with Dr. Grigoryan. I especially liked how she kept the classes structured; outlined what's to be covered, discussed concepts before explaining theories, then theory explanation, post theory activities, summarized what was taught and reviewed through kahoot. Dynamic sessions and lots of useful information.

A prof that I'll miss a lot !!!! Nice, gentle, and always there to help! You can chat with her about other stuffs as well ) and she likes to motivate and encourage. I really hope that she teaches other English courses as well. Simply one of the best!

Tsoghik is awesome. She's the best prof I've had at SFU so far. Lecturing is very interesting and she really tries to elicit class discussion -Really cares about participation and wants to know what you think Not judgmental at all/ respects students opinions -Gives very detailed feedback -Very available for help. love her classes!!!

The class structure was all over the place; there were no clear instructions on guidelines, deadlines, etc. All materials in lectures slides were AI-generated; I cannot read anything because it is all lumped together. Join the class if you want to practically be taught by AI and textbooks on "fork found in kitchen" concepts

I wish I could take a class with Tsogik again. We learned about how to cite and reference with zotero with her which saved my assignments. Her feedback is so good and grades fairly. Fal x99 class was hard for me but she stayed back to help after class and I appreciate it. I feel more confident in my writing now. Fully recommend her sessions. Thanks

Wow I jumped in to write comments about this course and I see today's AI class has been for some a challenge. I loved today's class, I actually watched the movie about Turing machine she asked us to. I'm happy that prof is so tech-oriented and doesn't use boring PPTs. AI is the future and we need to learn how to use it in education and at work.

Today's class was about AI challenges in education and though, if not all then most students use AI in their assignments they talked against and I see why. Prof was very helpful and shared prompt methods and educational AI. Showed pros and cons. She is pro AI and techy which is great. I learn a lot in her classes.

Very nice human being and a wonderful prof. No boring classes. She is very techy and knowledgeable. Walks with modern methods and ways of teaching. Love the polls and her prezi presentations. The major project is fun, especially with Mitra, a super TA. If you are a student who welcomes innovative thinking and flexibility, this is your prof.

Dr. Grigoryan is the kind of professor whose presence alone makes you want to engage in class. We often wish the class could continue longer. She creates interactive environment through Kahoot quizzes, Menti polls, Prezi and rewards Kahoot winners with chocolates, which adds a fun element to learning. My TA Mitra is also helpful and fun. Thanks.
Simply one of the best profs! Takes lectures to another level, love her classes. If you care about your knowledge and skills, take her class.

EDUC 240 introduces many unfamiliar concepts, but she explains everything through stories and real examples, making ideas easy to remember. Despite the 150+ student lecture hall, everyone stays engaged through interactive activities and new platforms. Time flies in class. Professional, supportive, and provides great feedback. Excellent instructor!

Super professor! Tsoghik is one of those profs that you want to stay in her class till the last second. The way she engages everyone in discussion and debates, explains theories and perspectives in EDUC240 is amazing. She is very professional, knowledgeable and a wonderful human. I'll look forward to registering to her other sessions. Recommended!

Very prompt and professional. I didn't see her physically the course was online she was a ta for the course but she graded all assignments very well and answered emails same day. Will definitely take any class with her again.

I took EDUC 322 (Social lives of school children course), and she graded so fairly and gave such good feedback about important concepts. Also, the grade and feedback she gives is almost immediate and so you know what to expect and how to improve for the next assignment. That course was online but heavy. She is a professional in her job.

Best prof ever!!! She knows her job, is professional, gives detailed feedback, classes are super helpful and informative, grades loyally, posts on time, comes on time, smiles and shows respect to everyone, encourages learning and thinking. Highly recommended!

I honestly feel like I've learned a lot already. She explains everything clearly and breaks down the writing in a way that actually makes sense. She also uses technology in class, which makes things more interactive and fun, not just a regular lecture. The expectations are clear, the feedback is helpful. I can already see improvement in my writing.
